description: This file is a shell script used for testing notes merging and conflict resolution in a Git repository. It sets up various scenarios, performs merges, resolves conflicts, and verifies the correctness of Git notes operations, making extensive use of Git commands and test utilities.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies the notes associated with a given notes ref by comparing the current notes and log to expected output files.

methods.name: notes_merge_files_gone
methods.description: Checks that no NOTES_MERGE_* files are left in the .git directory, indicating that the merge state has been cleaned up.
